review.summary: The plan is workable: the stop is a bit tight and should sit above 118.6, and the target can go to 108.5, just above the 50-day average. Leverage is OK. The direction is a coin flip.
risks: 50d avg ~107.2 holds from above more often than chance; the short runs into it fast
Stop 4.4% < 1 daily ATR (4.66%); a normal bounce into the 116-118 shelf could tag it
Limit at 112.3 needs a ~1.9% bounce first; if it doesn't fill, don't chase it at 110
review.would_change_mind: A daily close back above ~116.3 (4h 20/50 avg) means the dip is over. A close below 107 would justify a lower target.
